LESSON: BUSINESS GOALS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: BUSINESS STUDIES
Strand: Business and Money Management
Topic 1.2: Business Goals
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 13

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Business Goals, part of Business and Money Management in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 BUSINESS STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How are SMART short term and long term business goals formulated?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Business Goals together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: learner improves reading, listening, writing, speaking and teamwork skills

when discussing and presenting on the meaning and importance of setting business goals.

● Learning to learn: learner shares acquired knowledge when searching for information on the steps followed when

setting business goals.

● Self-efficacy: learner enhances effective communication skills when presenting on the importance and factors

considered when setting business goals.

● Critical thinking and problem solving: learner develops research and explanation skills when setting short term and

long term business goals.

7

Values:
● Respect: learner shows regard for contribution of other members of the group during discussions and presentations

on the meaning and importance of setting goals for business.

● Love: learners share knowledge when brainstorming and presenting on the factors to consider when setting

business goals.

● Peace: learner works in harmony with members of the class when brainstorming and presenting on factors to

consider when setting business goals.

● Social justice: learner exercises equity as they accord privileges without favour when using available resources to

search for information on the steps followed when setting business goals.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Financial Literacy: learner enhances skills in the management of financial resources when setting short term and

long term business goals.

● Social Cohesion: learner works in harmony with others when discussing and presenting on the meaning and

importance of setting business goals.
